builds.name: Reaping Slash: Rhaast two-hit health scaling
builds.summary: Investigate high one Rhaast Reaping Slash dash and sweep output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Rhaast Reaping Slash dash and sweep output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: The named Darkin helpers give 0.65 total AD flat damage and (6 + 0.035 bonus AD)% target maximum HP. The experiment tests their application to each of the dash and sweep rather than adding the ordinary 75/105/135/165/195 + 0.85 bonus AD form. A legacy raw effect still shows a different base percentage, so the exact live coefficient needs confirmation.

ceiling.targetName: one Rhaast Reaping Slash dash and sweep
ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 2s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop observed damage at death, cap observed healing at missing HP, and report raw output separately. Rhaast transformation legally earned and confirmed before testing. Exactly 10 earned Hubris kills with active temporary AD buff. One champion survives both dash and sweep within a two-second observation. Record each packet, actual form, total/bonus AD and target maximum HP; no W/R or healing in damage total.
